swap.title: Swap
swap.intro: Swap on RougeChain's native AMM. Every trade is quoted by the node, reviewed by you, and signed with post-quantum keys.
swap.ammInfo: Constant-product AMM (x·y=k) with a 0.3% fee that goes to liquidity providers.
swap.multiHop: No direct pool? The node routes through XRGE pairs automatically (multi-hop).
swap.noRoute: No route found for this pair
swap.quoteUnavailable: Quote unavailable — the node didn't answer. Try again.
swap.highImpact: High price impact: {{pct}}. You may receive much less than the market price.
swap.reviewNote: Output is estimated. If the price moves more than your slippage tolerance before the block, the swap fails and nothing is spent but the network fee.
swap.buyLink: Buy XRGE with ETH or USDC on Base

pools.title: Liquidity pools
pools.intro: Provide liquidity and earn 0.3% of every swap through your pool.
pools.error: Couldn't load pools from the node.
pools.emptyBody: Create the first pool to start trading on this network.
pools.noPositionsBody: Add liquidity to a pool and your position appears here.
pools.positionsNeedWallet: Connect a wallet to see your liquidity positions.
pools.earnInfo: Liquidity providers earn 0.3% on all trades, proportional to their share of the pool. Fees compound into the pool — use Collect fees to withdraw just your earnings and keep your deposit in place.

liquidity.ratioHint: Amounts follow the pool's current ratio, so adding doesn't move the price.
liquidity.firstLiquidity: This pool is empty: your amounts set its starting price.
liquidity.createFee: Pool creation fee: 10 XRGE. You receive LP tokens for your share (1,000 LP are locked forever as minimum liquidity).
liquidity.collectBody: Swap fees have grown your position by {{growth}} since you deposited. Collecting withdraws {{lp}} LP — just that growth — and your deposit stays in the pool earning. If the price has moved, the token mix follows the pool's current ratio.
liquidity.poolExists: Pool {{id}} already exists — add liquidity to it instead.

buy.title: Buy XRGE
buy.intro: XRGE trades on Base (Aerodrome). Buy it there with ETH or USDC, then bridge it to RougeChain.
buy.contractNote: Always check the contract address before you trade. Verify it on
buy.step1: Get ETH or USDC on Base (bridge from Ethereum, or withdraw from an exchange that supports Base).
buy.step2: Open Aerodrome and swap ETH or USDC for XRGE using the contract address above.
buy.step3: Keep XRGE on Base, or bridge it to RougeChain from the Bridge page.
buy.step4: On RougeChain, swap XRGE for other tokens here or provide liquidity to earn fees.
buy.disclaimer: Trading is at your own risk. Prices move; only trade what you can afford to lose. RougeChain doesn't operate Aerodrome.
